evaluation.justification: Your AI/Data Science background and hardware projects (plasma toroid, Arduino) show technical aptitude, but the Test Training Course targets space systems engineering and testing skills that your current curriculum does not cover. The ESA-Scout repository and mentoring experience are positive signals of interest, yet you are still in year two of a non-aerospace BSc with no documented space-domain experience. This makes the application a stretch that would require substantial preparation before the December deadline.
why_apply: Direct exposure to ESA testing protocols and space hardware facilities
Networking with ESA engineers and potential future internship leads
Opportunity to pivot your AI skills toward space data or autonomy applications
required_skills: Knowledge of space environment effects on components
gaps: No aerospace, mechanical or electrical engineering coursework
No prior space-related projects or internships
Limited demonstrated knowledge of ESA programmes or space standards
